title: Chapter 3
text: Author’s note This book winds through some dark places, and I want readers to be able to opt in or opt out at their leisure, so I’ve provided the following content guidance. A Dowry of Blood contains depictions of: ~ emotional, verbal, and physical intimate partner abuse ~ gaslighting ~ war, famine, and plague ~ blood and gore ~ consensual sexual content ~ sadomasochism ~ self-harm ~ body horror ~ violence and murder ~ alcohol use ~ depression and mania It also contains brief references to: ~ sexual assault (not directed at any named character) ~ drug use ~ drowning
